In pre-disaster times, such disks were used to store map archives, supply lists, personal files, and even secret military reports. Now it's a valuable find: it may contain important information — coordinates of forgotten warehouses, passwords from old systems, fortification diagrams, or records of group movements that can be extracted and used for their own purposes. Made by DayZavr project.

In the old world, they were installed on factory floors, in workshops and large hangars to evenly warm up the premises in winter. Now, in a world where fuel is running low, this spiral comes to life in makeshift heaters powered by generators: it warms tents in night ambushes or melts ice for drinking water. Made by DayZavr project.

Now it's an interesting find from the past, quite valuable: such antiques are always exchanged by traders exclusively for money — collectors among the survivors still pay good sums for them, as if the old world hadn't ended. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A long reinforced corrugated hose made of durable rubber is flexible, does not break when bent and withstands pressure. In the old world, it was used for irrigation, pumping water from barrels, washing machinery or connecting to pumps. Made by DayZavr project.

One sip and you're back in action. Made by DayZavr project.

Sometimes they are disassembled into rare components for soldering critical devices or exchanged entirely as one of the most valuable - brains- of the old world. Merchants pay very good money for it — it's not just a piece of hardware, but the key to restoring technology. Made by DayZavr project.
russian: Компактная плата с мощным программируемым логическим процессором Virtex, зелёной печатной платой, массивом контактов и металлическим радиатором для отвода тепла. В мире после краха такие высокотехнологичные чипы — редчайшая находка: их используют для ремонта или создания сложной электроники — от самодельных контроллеров для генераторов и солнечных систем до перепрограммирования старых радиостанций, дронов и систем наблюдения. Иногда разбирают на редкие компоненты для пайки критически важных устройств или обменивают целиком как один из самых ценных «мозгов» старого мира. Торговцы платят за него очень хорошие деньги — это не просто железка, а ключ к восстановлению технологий. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A luxurious wooden table clock with golden carvings in the form of a double-headed eagle, an orb, a scepter and a dial is a relic from the times of the former empire, expertly carved and decorated. In the post-collapse world, it is a valuable antique: it is placed in the center of the camp as a symbol of status and stability, the mechanism is used to repair other clocks or alarm clocks, and the frame serves as a stand for storing small tools or cartridges. If the clockwork still runs, it accurately measures the time for changing shifts or coordinating sorties. It's a very valuable item, and the merchants will give you decent money for it. Made by DayZavr project.

Мультикам-расцветка с выцветшими пятнами и потёртостями выдаёт реальный опыт: эта броня прошла через пыль, грязь и огонь, не раз спасая жизнь тому, кто её носил. Плиты держат удар, пока другие уже давно сдались, а система быстрого сброса даёт шанс выжить, если всё пошло не по плану. Вес в 13 кг — это цена за уверенность, что ты встанешь после попадания и продолжишь бой, когда враг уже празднует победу. Выбор тех, кто не просто выживает, а побеждает в любой мясорубке. Made by DayZavr project.
polish: An improved tactical vest of the American army, where every element is thought out for maximum freedom of movement in combat. The modular design with a high collar, side and groin guards allows you to quickly change the configuration for a task — from a light assault to a long patrol. The weight of 13 kg is the price for making sure that you get up after being hit and continue the fight when the enemy is already celebrating victory. The choice of those who not only survive, but win in any meat grinder. Made by DayZavr project.

Эта броня создана для прямого, жёсткого боя без компромиссов — когда другие ищут укрытие, Тагилла стоит и встречает огонь лицом к лицу. Выбор тех, кто предпочитает силу, скорость и абсолютную уверенность в том, что пока он в этой броне — враг должен бежать первым. Made by DayZavr project.

original: This is the pinnacle of tactical armor, where every element looks like it's from another world. The honeycomb-like structure of the plates gives the impression that they were carved from monolithic high-tech material, and the matte gray color absorbs light and makes the silhouette almost elusive. The high, rigid collar wraps tightly around the neck, protecting it from splinters and ricochets, and the massive ceramic plates of the highest class withstand hits that knock out any other armor. Reinforced sidewalls, groin protection and tight fasteners create the silhouette of a fighter who goes only forward — without doubt and without retreat. The Zhuk-6A is not just a defense, it's a symbol: when you're in it, the enemy already knows that there won't be a chance to leave. The choice of those who are used to solving everything with force and precision. Absolute top level, pure fire. Made by DayZavr project.

Это не просто жилет — это мобильная крепость, созданная для тех, кто идёт в лобовой штурм, где другие уже давно лежат. Когда ты в 6Б43, ты не прячешься — ты заставляешь мир прятаться от тебя. Великолепный, не имеющий равных в своём классе. Made by DayZavr project.

original: An old, faded gray vest soaked in the dust of abandoned industrial zones and the smell of gun oil. The mesh base has already worn down to threads in places, and the plastic inserts are covered with small cracks from falls and impacts on concrete. It is lightweight, almost does not feel on the body, allows you to breathe even in the stuffy heat and does not cling to branches or rebar when moving quickly. This is the armor of those who do not expect to be saved by plates worth a hundred thousand, but simply put on what is at hand and move on. The PACA doesn't shout about status — it silently takes hits that should have gone through, and sometimes it still holds. The straps, darkened by time, do not fall apart, the zippers do not jam, and the whole structure seems to be used to being worn for real, and not on parade. There's not an ounce of heroism in it, just a stubborn habit of staying alive when everything is over. Made by DayZavr project.

original: The Kirasa body armor is a lightweight vest made of coarse denim with a high collar, which looks like it was sewn in a basement for those who cannot afford normal armor, but still want at least something on their chest. The fabric is already soaked in sweat, campfire smoke and engine oil, the collar is stiff as a board from constant wear under the jacket, and the pockets on the chest are stretched from magazines and grenades. It weighs almost nothing, does not warm your back in the heat and does not cling to everything when you need to quickly climb over a fence or fall into a ditch. This is an armor on the edge — it doesn't hold anything serious at point-blank range, but sometimes it saves you from a ricochet or shrapnel, giving you an extra second to return fire. The Kirasa is chosen by those who have long since stopped believing in perfect protection and just cling to any little thing that might delay the end. Simple construction, no unnecessary slings and zippers — just fabric, ceramics inside and the stubborn hope that it will work again today. There is not a hint of the elite in it, only the smell of real war and the fatigue of endless walking on the edge. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Бронежилет «Кираса» — лёгкий жилет из грубой джинсовой ткани с высоким воротом, который выглядит так, будто его сшили в подвале для тех, кто не может позволить себе нормальную броню, но всё равно хочет хоть что-то на груди. Ткань уже пропиталась потом, дымом костров и машинным маслом, воротник стоит колом от постоянного ношения под курткой, а карманы на груди растянуты от магазинов и гранат. Он почти не весит, не греет спину в жару и не цепляется за всё подряд, когда нужно быстро перелезть через забор или упасть в канаву. Это броня на грани — не держит ничего серьёзного в упор, но иногда спасает от рикошета или шрапнели, давая лишнюю секунду, чтобы ответить огнём. Кирасу берут те, кто давно перестал верить в идеальную защиту и просто цепляется за любую мелочь, которая может оттянуть конец. Простая конструкция, никаких лишних строп и молний — только ткань, керамика внутри и упрямая надежда, что сегодня она снова сработает. В ней нет ни намёка на элиту, только запах реальной войны и усталость от бесконечного хождения по краю. Made by DayZavr project.
polish: The Kirasa body armor is a lightweight vest made of coarse denim with a high collar, which looks like it was sewn in a basement for those who cannot afford normal armor, but still want at least something on their chest. The fabric is already soaked in sweat, campfire smoke and engine oil, the collar is stiff as a board from constant wear under the jacket, and the pockets on the chest are stretched from magazines and grenades. It weighs almost nothing, does not warm your back in the heat and does not cling to everything when you need to quickly climb over a fence or fall into a ditch. This is an armor on the edge — it doesn't hold anything serious at point-blank range, but sometimes it saves you from a ricochet or shrapnel, giving you an extra second to return fire. The Kirasa is chosen by those who have long since stopped believing in perfect protection and just cling to any little thing that might delay the end. Simple construction, no unnecessary slings and zippers — just fabric, ceramics inside and the stubborn hope that it will work again today. There is not a hint of the elite in it, only the smell of real war and the fatigue of endless walking on the edge. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A blue vest that immediately gives away belonging to those who once went to assault groups in industrial zones and residential areas. Heavy, almost eight kilos, with thick horizontal reinforcement bands and rough slings, it fits like a glove, but makes your shoulders ache after just a couple of hours of wearing it in the rain. The blue color has long been tarnished by dirt and soot, and the plastic inserts are covered with scratches from falls on asphalt and impacts on metal. This is not an elite plate carrier, but a typical group armor — it holds shrapnel and pistol bullets, and gives you the feeling that you are not completely naked when you go on a sweep. The Untar is chosen by those who work in a team and do not want to stand out: the inscription on the chest speaks for you, and the weight reminds you that it's not about speed, but about getting up and moving on after hitting. The sturdy straps don't tear, the mesh underneath lets in air even in the heat, and the whole structure seems designed to survive another shift in this hell. There is no romance in it — just the smell of sweat, gunpowder and the certainty that today it will earn its price again. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Синий жилет, который сразу выдаёт принадлежность к тем, кто когда-то ходил в штурмовые группы по промзонам и жилым кварталам. Тяжёлый, почти восемь кило, с толстыми горизонтальными полосами усиления и грубыми стропами, он сидит как влитой, но заставляет плечи ныть уже через пару часов ношения под дождём. Синий цвет давно потускнел от грязи и копоти, а пластиковые вставки покрылись царапинами от падений на асфальт и ударов о металл. Это не элитная плитоноска, а типичная групповая броня — держит осколки и пистолетные пули, даёт ощущение, что ты не совсем голый, когда идёшь в зачистку. Унтар выбирают те, кто работает в команде и не хочет выделяться: надпись на груди говорит за тебя, а вес напоминает, что здесь не про скорость, а про то, чтобы встать и идти дальше после попадания. Прочные ремни не рвутся, сетка под ними пропускает воздух даже в жару, а вся конструкция будто создана для того, чтобы пережить ещё одну смену в этом аду. В нём нет романтики — только запах пота, пороха и уверенность, что сегодня он снова отработает свою цену. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A dark blue vest with a high collar and tight side fasteners, which looks like it was made for those who work in the front rows but don't like too much attention. The stains of dirt, soot, and old blood have already eaten into the fabric, making it almost blend in with the twilight and wet asphalt after the rain. It's not too heavy, but it feels on your shoulders as a reminder that protection always comes at a price in the form of fatigue and sweat. The high collar wraps tightly around the neck, protecting it from ricochets and cold wind when lying for hours in wet grass or on a concrete floor. This is medium-level armor - it holds shrapnel and pistol hits, but it won't save you from a serious caliber at point-blank range, and the owner knows this better than anyone. The Zhuk-3 is chosen by those who are used to the routine of sweeps and do not chase after the top plates, but simply want to make it to the end of the shift without unnecessary holes in the body. The sturdy slings do not fall apart from constant wear, and the whole structure seems to be saturated with the smell of gunpowder and wet earth, reminding us that war is not about shine, but about getting up and moving on. There is no heroic gloss in it, only cold practicality and the habit of surviving where others have long since broken down. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A lightweight fabric helmet with a soft lining and wide straps, which looks more like an old army cap with protection than a serious combat headdress. The olive color has already faded in the sun and is stained with rain, dirt and sweat, and the mesh inserts are saturated with the smell of smoke and engine oil. It is almost imperceptible on the head — ideal for long walks, when every extra gram makes the neck ache, and does not prevent you from hearing footsteps in the foliage or rustling in the bushes. This is basic protection for those who can't afford heavy Kevlar monsters, but still want something between a skull and what's flying from above. The Kiver-M holds small fragments and random ricochets, giving you a chance to dodge or respond when you can't do it in time. It is taken by beginners, couriers and those who work in the rear, where there is a risk, but not at the frontline meat grinder. A simple, cheap, reliable helmet in its minimality, which does not promise miracles, but simply allows you to get up after a fall and go on in this endless gray bullshit. Made by DayZavr project.

It is light, almost does not feel on the head, but tightly wraps around the ears, muffling external sounds and giving a chance to hear the order or footsteps of the enemy through the roar of battle. This is a basic level of protection — it holds small fragments and accidental tangential hits, but at close range from a serious caliber it will just give you a couple of extra seconds to understand that it's over. The tanker helmet is worn by those who sit at the controls, in the turret or in a cramped compartment, where every gram on the head is already too much, but there is absolutely no way without it. The sturdy fasteners do not fly off when shaking and falling, and the inner lining, although worn out, still softens impacts on metal. There is nothing superfluous in it — just the cold practicality of old military equipment and the habit of surviving in an iron box, where someone always wants to get you from the outside. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Тёмный, почти чёрный танковый шлемофон с толстыми мягкими наушниками и жёстким металлическим каркасом, который выглядит так, будто его вытащили из старой БМП после десятка лет в гараже и пыли. Ткань пропиталась запахом солярки, пота и старого порохового дыма, а ремни с потемневшими пряжками скрипят при каждом движении головы. Он лёгкий, почти не ощущается на голове, но плотно обхватывает уши, глуша внешние звуки и давая шанс услышать приказ или шаги врага сквозь грохот боя. Это базовый уровень защиты — держит мелкие осколки и случайные касательные попадания, но в упор от серьёзного калибра просто даст тебе пару лишних секунд, чтобы понять, что всё кончилось. Шлемофон берут те, кто сидит за рычагами, в башне или в тесном отсеке, где каждый грамм на голове — это уже перебор, но без него совсем никак. Прочные крепления не слетают при тряске и падениях, внутренняя подкладка хоть и износилась, но всё ещё смягчает удары о металл. В нём нет ничего лишнего — только холодная практичность старой военной техники и привычка выживать в железной коробке, где снаружи всегда кто-то хочет тебя достать. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A good old helmet with a wide brim and a thick transparent face shield that looks like it was pulled out of a forgotten army depot and has already survived more than one campaign in the dust and dirt. The metal shell is covered with a layer of worn paint, peeling in places to gray metal, and the inner green balaclava is soaked with sweat and the smell of gun oil from dozens of owners. It's heavy, but it fits snugly, doesn't dangle when running, and doesn't slip off when you fall face-first into the mud or bump into a wall. The visor gives a good view even at dusk, protects the eyes from dust, branches and small fragments, and the whole structure seems to be designed for those who climb into the thick of it, where everything is raining down from above. Kolpak-1S holds the blows better than it looks — fragments from grenades and ricochets fly off, giving a chance to stay in the game when others are already down. It is worn by those who value old-school reliability, rather than fashionable lightweight Kevlar buckets, and are willing to bear the weight in order to keep their head intact in a meat grinder. The sturdy straps with rough buckles do not tear, the visor does not crack from the first blow, and it feels the same stubborn confidence of a veteran who knows: This thing has already saved more than once, and it won't let you down today either. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Старый добротный шлем с широким козырьком и толстым прозрачным забралом, который выглядит так, будто его вытащили из забытого армейского склада и он уже пережил не одну кампанию в пыли и грязи. Металлическая оболочка покрыта слоем потёртой краски, местами облупившейся до серого металла, а внутренний зелёный подшлемник пропитался потом и запахом оружейного масла от десятков владельцев. Он тяжёлый, но сидит плотно, не болтается при беге и не сползает, когда падаешь лицом в грязь или врезаешься в стену. Забрало даёт хороший обзор даже в сумерках, защищает глаза от пыли, веток и мелких осколков, а вся конструкция будто создана для тех, кто лезет в самую гущу, где сверху сыплется всё подряд. Колпак-1С держит удары лучше, чем кажется на вид — осколки от гранат и рикошеты отлетают, давая шанс остаться в игре, когда другие уже лежат. Его носят те, кто ценит надёжность старой школы, а не модные лёгкие кевларовые ведра, и готов терпеть вес ради того, чтобы голова осталась целой в мясорубке. Прочные ремни с грубыми пряжками не рвутся, козырёк не трескается от первого же удара, а в нём чувствуется та самая упрямая уверенность ветерана, который знает: эта штука уже спасала не раз и сегодня тоже не подведёт. Made by DayZavr project.

It wraps tightly around the head, does not slip off in jerks and allows you to quickly turn your neck when you need to catch movement in the scope or hear a rustle behind your back. The visor holds dust, branches and small fragments, giving a chance to stay in battle when everything around has already turned into chaos. ZSH-1-2M is chosen by those who have gone through more than one sweep and know: This thing won't let you down at a critical moment, even if other models have already cracked. The sturdy construction dampens impacts, and the entire shape seems designed to keep the head in place while the body continues to move forward through smoke and blood. It has the cold confidence of a veteran — not pathos, but just the habit of surviving where others have long since given up. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A dark, almost black helmet with a wide visor and massive side mounts, which looks as if it was forged specifically for those who go into the thick of it, where the air is thick with gunpowder and shrapnel. The surface is covered with a layer of ingrained dirt, soot and small dents from the hits, which no longer rub off, but only add character. It's heavy, but it sits rock-solid — the visor is lowered tightly, the straps with coarse buckles do not allow you to move a millimeter even when falling from a running start or hitting concrete. The LSHZ-2DTM withstands what has long turned other helmets into scrap metal, giving you a chance to get up after a hit that should have ended everything at once. It is worn by those who are used to real work: assaults, sweeps in cramped corridors, where everything is raining down from above and every step is a challenge. The sturdy construction does not crack from splinters, the internal suspension dampens the shock wave, and the entire shape seems to be saturated with the smell of a real meat grinder and the stubborn belief that the head must remain intact at all costs. There is no room for weakness in it — only a cold, proven reliability that makes enemies think twice before aiming at someone wearing such a helmet. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Тёмный, почти чёрный шлем с широким забралом и массивными боковыми креплениями, который выглядит так, будто его ковали специально для тех, кто идёт в самую гущу, где воздух густой от пороха и осколков. Поверхность покрыта слоем въевшейся грязи, копоти и мелкими вмятинами от попаданий, которые уже не оттираются, а только добавляют характера. Он тяжёлый, но сидит мёртво — забрало опускается плотно, ремни с грубыми пряжками не дают сдвинуться ни на миллиметр даже при падении с разбега или ударе о бетон. ЛШЗ-2ДТМ держит то, от чего другие шлемы давно превращаются в металлолом, давая шанс встать после того, что должно было закончить всё одним касанием. Его носят те, кто привык к настоящей работе: штурмы, зачистки в тесных коридорах, где сверху сыплется всё подряд и каждый шаг — это вызов. Прочная конструкция не трескается от осколков, внутренняя подвеска гасит ударную волну, а вся форма будто пропитана запахом реальной мясорубки и упрямой уверенностью, что голова должна остаться целой любой ценой. В нём нет места для слабости — только холодная, проверенная в деле надёжность, которая заставляет врагов думать дважды, прежде чем целиться в того, кто в таком шлеме. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A massive gray helmet with a futuristic visor and mirrored purple-blue visors, which looks like it was taken from an elite mercenary accustomed to working in complete darkness and under heavy fire. The surface is covered with small scratches from shrapnel and ricochets, and the angular plates seem to be chiseled in order to deflect bullets and force enemies to spend an extra second aiming. It's heavy, but perfectly balanced — it doesn't put pressure on your neck even after hours of wearing, and the visors give you a clear view in any weather, from rain to smoke. Ronin holds something that makes most helmets just shatter into pieces, giving you a chance to stand up after a direct hit and respond in kind. It is worn by those who have long gone beyond the ordinary infantry: night raids, assaults on fortified points, where every meter is a fight to the death. The sturdy fasteners do not fly off from the blast wave, the internal shock absorption system dampens the impact, and the entire silhouette of the helmet screams that the owner has come not just to survive, but to finish the job. There is no room for doubt in it — only cold, honed rage and the certainty that his head will remain on his shoulders while his enemies are still breathing. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Массивный серый шлем с футуристическим забралом и зеркальными фиолетово-синими визорами, который выглядит так, будто его сняли с элитного наёмника, привыкшего работать в полной темноте и под шквальным огнём. Поверхность покрыта мелкими царапинами от осколков и рикошетов, а угловатые пластины будто выточены для того, чтобы отводить пули и заставлять врагов тратить лишнюю секунду на прицеливание. Он тяжёлый, но сбалансирован идеально — не давит на шею даже после часов ношения, а визоры дают чёткий обзор в любую погоду, от дождя до дыма. Ронин держит то, от чего большинство шлемов просто разлетается в куски, давая шанс встать после прямого попадания и ответить тем же. Его носят те, кто давно вышел за рамки обычной пехоты: ночные рейды, штурмы укреплённых точек, где каждый метр — это бой насмерть. Прочные крепления не слетают от взрывной волны, внутренняя система амортизации гасит удар, а весь силуэт шлема будто кричит о том, что владелец пришёл не просто выжить, а закончить дело. В нём нет места сомнениям — только холодная, отточенная ярость и уверенность, что голова останется на плечах, пока враги ещё дышат. Made by DayZavr project.
polish: A massive gray helmet with a futuristic visor and mirrored purple-blue visors, which looks like it was taken from an elite mercenary accustomed to working in complete darkness and under heavy fire. The surface is covered with small scratches from shrapnel and ricochets, and the angular plates seem to be chiseled in order to deflect bullets and force enemies to spend an extra second aiming. It's heavy, but perfectly balanced — it doesn't put pressure on your neck even after hours of wearing, and the visors give you a clear view in any weather, from rain to smoke. Ronin holds something that makes most helmets just shatter into pieces, giving you a chance to stand up after a direct hit and respond in kind. It is worn by those who have long gone beyond the ordinary infantry: night raids, assaults on fortified points, where every meter is a fight to the death. The sturdy fasteners do not fly off from the blast wave, the internal shock absorption system dampens the impact, and the entire silhouette of the helmet screams that the owner has come not just to survive, but to finish the job. There is no room for doubt in it — only cold, honed rage and the certainty that his head will remain on his shoulders while his enemies are still breathing. Made by DayZavr project.

original: The legendary helmet with massive triangular visors and a thick steel shell, which has become a symbol of those who walk away unscathed from the wildest shootouts and leave only smoke and corpses behind. The surface is covered with a layer of ingrained soot, dents from ricochets and traces of blood that can no longer be washed off with anything but a new portion of lead. It is heavy, like war itself, but it sits rock-solid on the head and won't shift in a fall from a height or from a direct rifle-butt blow. The RysT holds something that turns other helmets into a sieve, giving you a chance to stand up, shake off the dust and continue hunting while the enemies are still writhing. It's worn by the elite — those loners and assault troops who know the value of real armor and don't waste time on lightweight Kevlar toys. The durable visor hinges do not jam in mud or rain, the inner lining dampens the shock wave, and the silhouette of the helmet forces the opponent to aim twice before pulling the trigger. An absolute top, pure impenetrable power for those who are born in the fire and come out of it victorious. Made by DayZavr project.

russian: Легендарный шлем с массивными треугольными визорами и толстой стальной оболочкой, который стал символом тех, кто выходит сухим из самых диких перестрелок и оставляет за собой только дым и трупы. Поверхность покрыта слоем въевшейся копоти, вмятинами от рикошетов и следами крови, которые уже не отмыть ничем, кроме новой порции свинца. Он тяжёлый, как сама война, но сидит мёртво на голове, не давая сдвинуться ни при падении с высоты, ни при прямом ударе прикладом. Рысь-Т держит то, от чего другие шлемы превращаются в решето, давая шанс встать, стряхнуть пыль и продолжить охоту, пока враги ещё корчатся. Его носит элита — те одиночки и штурмовики, кто знает цену настоящей броне и не тратит время на лёгкие кевларовые игрушки. Прочные петли забрала не заедают в грязи или под дождём, внутренняя подкладка гасит ударную волну, а силуэт шлема заставляет противника целиться дважды, прежде чем нажать на спуск. Абсолютный топ, чистая непробиваемая мощь для тех, кто рождён в огне и выходит из него победителем. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A legend among those who walk the edge and come back when the rest have already become fertilizer for the grass. A heavy steel mask with wide white stripes, covered with bullet dents and dried enemy blood, looks as if death itself decided to put it on and go into battle. A narrow slit for the eyes gives a cold view, and thick armor holds something that blows heads to pieces in a second. The Maska-1SCh Killa is not just a helmet, it is a verdict for anyone who dares to stand in the way of the owner: in it you become the very monster that is feared even in the darkest corners of the zone. It is worn only by elite assault troops, who do not hide behind their backs, but walk in front and leave silence behind them. Strong fasteners will not let you down in the wildest meat grinder, and the whole silhouette makes the enemy tremble with his finger on the trigger, knowing that today he is finished. The absolute top, the invincible steel, the choice of those who have long since stopped counting the survivors and just move on, leaving only corpses behind. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A simple blue backpack with no extra bells and whistles, which looks like it was dragged through mountains and swamps until the fabric was soaked with sweat, dirt and the smell of wet earth. The red trekking poles sit firmly on the side, reminding of those who used it for long marches through ruins and forests, where every gram counts. The volume is average, enough for a basic set — cartridges, canned food and a first-aid kit, but do not expect miracles in cramped corridors or when fully loaded in the rain. The straps are rigid, distribute the weight evenly, do not rub the shoulders even after a whole day in the field, and the side pockets allow you to quickly get a knife or a flask at the most inopportune moment. This is not an elite container for the rich, but a time-tested thing for those who survive on leftovers and do not chase volume. Redfox silently carries your burden through mud and blood, without letting you down in a routine where other backpacks have already burst at the seams. In it, you feel like the very survivor who knows there is no such thing as too much, and the main thing is to make it to the end. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A narrow black backpack with a white cross on the side, which looks like it was dragged by medics through the dirtiest sweeps, where every inch is saturated with the smell of blood and antiseptic. Tight straps keep it from dangling even when running through ruins or falling into a trench. The volume is enough for exactly what a survivor needs in the field — bandages, syringes, painkillers and a couple of grenades, without extra space for junk, which will only slow down. This is not a bulky container for looters, but a workhorse for those who have patched wounds under fire and know that an extra first aid kit can save their ass at the most inopportune moment. The medpack sits snugly on its side, does not interfere with aiming, and opens quickly with one hand when seconds count. A time-tested mid-range pack who silently carries his burden through the mud, sweat and screams of the wounded, without letting down in a routine where death is always one step behind. In it, you feel like the same field surgeon who brings fighters back into service while others just lie there and wait for the end. Made by DayZavr project.

The volume is enough for exactly what a survivor needs in the field — bandages, syringes, painkillers and a couple of grenades, without extra space for junk, which will only slow down. This is not a bulky container for looters, but a workhorse for those who have patched wounds under fire and know that an extra first aid kit can save their ass at the most inopportune moment. The medpack sits snugly on its side, does not interfere with aiming, and opens quickly with one hand when seconds count. A time-tested mid-range pack who silently carries his burden through the mud, sweat and screams of the wounded, without letting down in a routine where death is always one step behind. In it, you feel like the same field surgeon who brings fighters back into service while others just lie there and wait for the end. Made by DayZavr project.
russian: Узкий чёрный рюкзак с белым крестом на боку, который выглядит так, будто его таскали медики через самые грязные зачистки, где каждый сантиметр пропитан запахом крови и антисептика. Плотные ремни не дают ему болтаться даже при беге по руинам или падении в окоп. Объёма хватает ровно на то, что нужно выживальщику в поле — бинты, шприцы, обезбол и пару гранат, без лишнего места для хлама, который только замедлит. Это не громоздкий контейнер для лутеров, а рабочая лошадка для тех, кто латал раны под огнём и знает, что лишняя аптечка может спасти задницу в самый неподходящий момент. Медпак сидит плотно на боку, не мешает прицеливанию и быстро открывается одной рукой, когда секунды на счету. Проверенный временем середняк, который молча несёт свою ношу сквозь грязь, пот и крики раненых, не подводя в рутине, где смерть всегда на шаг позади. В нём чувствуешь себя тем самым полевым хирургом, который возвращает бойцов в строй, пока другие просто лежат и ждут конца. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A simple, battered blue sports bag, soaked in the smell of dampness, old sweat and gun oil after hundreds of kilometers through mud and ruins. The volume allows you to fill it to the brim with cartridges, canned food and spare barrels, without turning into a heavy bag that pulls down when running. A mesh side pocket and a thick rope on top make it possible to quickly grab a flask or knife when seconds decide everything, and the straps sit tight and do not cut into the shoulders even after a full day in the field. This is not a fashionable backpack for show, but an honest workhorse for those who are used to carrying everything they need and returning alive from the dirtiest outings. The sports bag opens with one hand in any position, the zippers do not jam from blood and rain, and the whole structure seems to remember everyone who carried it through the meat grinder and survived. There is no unnecessary pathos in it — just a cold confidence that today it will hold up again and carry you to a safe place. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A green camouflage backpack with thick MOLLE slings and a carabiner on the side, which looks like it was dragged by scavengers through the dirtiest landfills and abandoned bunkers, where every pocket is saturated with the smell of rust and fresh blood. The volume allows you to fill it to the brim with loot from the raid — from canned food and first-aid kits to spare magazines, without turning into a bulky bag that clings to everything in tight corridors. The straps are rigid, distributing the weight evenly even when fully loaded in heavy rain, and the side pockets with a bottle and a red bag give quick access to small items when you need to rush without looking back. This is not an elite container for the rich, but a typical workhorse for those who rummage through garbage cans and come out with trophies, risking their skin for every gram. The Scav backpack sits snugly on its back, does not dangle when jumping over fences or falling into a ditch, and the carabiners secure the bundles so that nothing falls off in the meat grinder. A time-tested mid-range pack who silently carries your prey through mud and lead, without letting you down in the routine of endless outings. You feel like the kind of scavenger who knows that volume is not a luxury, but a chance to return alive with a full pocket. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A narrow sand backpack with stiff slings and frayed pockets that looks like it was dragged by gunmen through the dustiest shootouts, where the fabric absorbed blood, sand and the smell of a hot barrel. The long body allows you to stuff barrels and magazines in there without too much volume on the sides, without interfering with maneuvers in cramped corridors or behind shelters. The straps wrap tightly around the back, do not rub even after a day in the field under the scorching sun, and the zippers open quietly, with one hand, when the enemy is already close. This is not a bulky bag for looters, but a work item for those who appreciate speed and do not chase after extra space in the routine of sweeps. Gunslinger silently carries your gear through dust storms and leaden rain, without tearing or letting you down at the moment when you need to rush forward. In it, you feel like the cowboy of the Zone, who is always ready for the next shot and returns with the loot. Made by DayZavr project.

Камуфляж в лесных тонах сливается с любой местностью, где смерть поджидает за каждым деревом, а ткань держит следы грязи и пороха как медали за выживание. Надёжные лямки и жёсткая конструкция не дают сползти даже на бегу под шквальным огнём, сохраняя баланс и свободу движений. Среди бывалых его ценят за то, что он превращает тяжёлый груз в привычку, а не в проклятие, позволяя вернуться с трофеями из самых безнадёжных вылазок. Это не просто рюкзак, а надёжный партнёр, пропитанный потом ветеранов и готовый к новым мясорубкам без единой жалобы. Made by DayZavr project.
polish: A legend among raiders, this backpack swallows gear without measure and does not give up even on the longest and bloodiest trek through the zone. Its narrow profile allows you to squeeze through where others get stuck, and its colossal volume makes it possible to fill everything you need to the brim without compromise. Camouflage in forest tones merges with any terrain, where death awaits behind every tree, and the fabric holds traces of dirt and gunpowder like medals for survival. Reliable straps and rigid construction do not allow you to slip even on the run under heavy fire, maintaining balance and freedom of movement. Among the seasoned, it is valued for turning a heavy load into a habit rather than a curse, allowing you to return with trophies from the most hopeless sorties. This is not just a backpack, but a reliable partner soaked in the sweat of veterans and ready for new meat grinders without a single complaint. Made by DayZavr project.

original: This beast is a real loot eater, created for those who drag out of the zone everything that isn't nailed down, and a bit more on top. The huge volume allows you to stuff it to the very top with cartridges, medicines and captured hardware without the slightest chance of compromise. The high fit and thoughtful design turn even an exorbitant weight into a tolerable burden that can be carried across the entire map without losing pace. The tattered black fabric is soaked in the smell of gunpowder, engine oil and old blood, and it keeps its shape even after falling from heights and long firefights in the mud. Side pockets and quick-release flaps give instant access to what you need without unnecessary movements when seconds decide everything. Among stalkers, it is simply called the Mechanism because it works like a well-functioning machine without asking questions or breaking down under load. The choice of those who go far and come back with full hands. Made by DayZavr project.

original: This monster is an absolute king of capacity, created for those who go on a raid for a few days and come back with a whole warehouse of trophies on their backs. The huge volume and towering design make it possible to fill it to capacity with everything that can be dragged out of the zone without the slightest hint of compromise. The high-riding fit distributes the monstrous weight so competently that even with full ammunition and a lot of iron, you move almost as if without a load. The battered light fabric with mud stains and traces of long wear merges with any landscape where you need to drag yourself for hours in the open air. Multiple flap pockets and quick-release fasteners provide instant access to what you need, even when bullets are whistling around and there is no time to dig. Among stalkers, it is simply called Paratus because it doesn't just carry things — it allows you to survive where others have long abandoned everything and ran light. The choice of elite raiders who go far deep and always come back with their hands full.

original: This rigid box with a heavy frame and a massive golden latch on the lid is the choice of those who prefer steel reliability instead of soft rags and are ready to carry the load like a real rampart on their back. The narrow elongated silhouette allows you to glide between trees and concrete crevices where any wide bag instantly catches on and gives out a position. The high construction turns it into a bottomless well where all the ammunition fits, plus trophies from a couple of fresh corpses without a single free corner. The hard walls do not sag even after jumping from roofs and crawling through mud for a long time, and the MOLLE mesh on top and sides is ready to accept any additional iron right in battle. The black tattered fabric with deep scratches and the ingrained smell of cordite and rust gives away a veteran who has been through dozens of meat grinders and still stands rooted to the spot. Among the old raiders, it is simply called Pillbox because it takes a punch like a real firing point and never fails when the rest are already falling under the weight. This is not a fashionable bag, but a working fortress that makes a long raid bearable and returning with full hands is a matter of habit. Made by DayZavr project.

original: The T20 backpack. This compact veteran with battered sand-colored fabric and rusty old bloodstains is the perfect companion for quick trips when you need to take only the essentials and not carry extra ballast. The narrow profile allows you to squeeze into tight crevices and basements where any wide backpack becomes a trap and the tall shape swallows long objects like gun barrels or tools without problems. The rigid MOLLE bands on the sides and front are ready to accept additional pouches for cartridges or grenades, making it versatile for urban mopping up or forest patrol. The smell of old sweat and rotten foliage reminds of nights in damp trenches where he saved more than one life simply by not letting down at the most critical moment. The adjustable padded shoulder straps do not rub even after hours of marching in the rain, and the quick-release flap gives instant access to the first-aid kit when seconds count. Among survivalists, he is appreciated for the fact that he does not attract attention and does not interfere with movement, becoming an extension of the body and not a burden. This is a workhorse for those who know the value of minimalism in a world where every extra gram can cost a life. Made by DayZavr project.

The coarse, dense fabric is saturated with the smell of fire smoke, wet earth and engine oil, and holds its shape after falling into the mud and lying in wait for a long time. The short shoulder straps and chest strap distribute the weight tolerably but make you feel every kilogram when you have to trudge through a swamp or uphill. Side pockets and external loops for attaching additional equipment make it convenient for those who work in a group and constantly change the contents. Among contract soldiers and old wolves, he is respected for not breaking down, not attracting too much attention, and just doing his job year after year without any show-off. This is not a fashionable tactical backpack, but an ordinary army classic that has survived more than one rotation and is still on duty.

original: A bunch of old capacitors, soldered from burnt-out machinery or found in dusty boxes of abandoned factories. In skilled hands, these cylinders with wire fragments become the basis for makeshift battery charging circuits or smoothing voltage surges in generators running on stale diesel. Local engineers and stalker repairmen hunt them down to fix the radio on the tower or start a rusty pump pumping water from an underground source. Without them, it is impossible to revive any more or less complex device, and therefore even such a small thing is extremely valuable. Made by DayZavr project.

original: A specially enlarged plastic velcro cuff is visible even on the massive shoulders of bulletproof vests and on top of chest rigs, when an ordinary armband simply cannot be seen in the thick of battle. The matte plastic is already covered with small scratches from branches and walls, the edges are slightly melted from accidental sparks from campfires, but the Velcro still holds tight. The fighters of the groups sew them on their sleeves so that in the confusion of the sweep or at the crossroads of hostile territories, their own would identify you a second before the shot was fired. The color is important here — it either saves or condemns, so the former owners often leave with the cuff. It's a silent thing, but it speaks louder than any shout: this guy is with those who are best left alone. Made by DayZavr project.

Матовый пластик уже покрылся мелкими царапинами от веток и стен, края чуть оплавились от случайных искр костров, но липучка всё ещё держит мёртво. Такие нашивают себе на рукав бойцы группировок, чтобы в суматохе зачистки или на перекрёстке враждебных территорий свои опознали тебя за секунду до выстрела. Цвет здесь имеет значение — он либо спасает, либо приговаривает, поэтому бывшие владельцы часто уходят вместе с манжетой. Вещь молчаливая, но говорит громче любого окрика: этот парень с теми, кого лучше не трогать. Made by DayZavr project.
